$comment: Screenshots allowed to stay taller than MAX_HEIGHT in e2e/screenshotSize.ts, which is the design 12.3 size gate. Same bargain as security/audit-exceptions.json: every entry names a reason, an owner and an expiry, the gate fails once an expiry passes, and it fails again once a listed shot comes in comfortably under the limit -- so an entry cannot outlive the fix it was waiting for, and nothing lives here by being forgotten. A shot that is simply too tall belongs in the spec that takes it, not here.

exceptions.reason: Full-page phone shots of the provider dashboard, which is as tall as the practice's visit list: by the time the mobile project runs, that is every patient every other spec booked, and these come out between 21,000 and 31,000 pixels. T57 (#87) is the ticket that replaces the hardcoded `fullPage: true` in these specs with a per-project default; delete these entries with it.

Full-page phone shots of pages that are long by design rather than by data -- the clinician's brief, the printed sheet, settings, the patient summary, the landing page -- at between 4,200 and 7,700 pixels. Each needs the same judgement T57 (#87) applies to the dashboard: either the page is worth a whole-page phone shot and the gate is wrong about it, or the shot wants its subject scrolled up and a screenful taken. Not T61's call to make spec by spec.

The same pages on the desktop project, at between 4,300 and 6,200 pixels. A desktop row is one line of a table rather than five stacked ones, so these are the only desktop shots over the limit at all, and they are over it for the same reason: a list that grows a row per booked visit. Same owner as the phone shots above.
